properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 30 at 2:05PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to reach major flood in the next
few hours. The anticipated crest is expected to be between 39 and
39.5 feet. Crest timing has been delayed to early Saturday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 30 at 4:51PM CDT until July 30 at 10:45PM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
FFWABR

The National Weather Service in Aberdeen has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Brown County in northeastern South Dakota...
Western Day County in northeastern South Dakota...

* Until 1045 PM CDT.

* At 451 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1.5 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Aberdeen, Groton, Bath, Columbia, Westport, Putney, Tacoma Park,
Sand Lake Wildlife Refuge, Houghton, Barnard and Richmond Lake Rec
Area.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued July 30 at 8:07PM EDT until July 30 at 8:30PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Apalachee Bay or Coastal Waters From Keaton Beach to Ochlockonee
River Fl out to 20 Nm...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...

* Until 830 PM EDT.

* At 807 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 20 nm northeast of
Buckeye Reef, moving southeast at 30 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots...suddenly higher
waves...frequent lightning...and heavy downpours. Make
sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.description:

miles southeast of Stapleton, moving southeast at 25 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Arnold, Callaway, Logan, Finchville, Etna, and Milldale.

This includes Highway 92 between mile markers 236 and 255.
